title: upgrade attention kernels to FlashAttentionV2 + fused-rope ops and KV cache scheduling optimizations
author: Ravi Kapoor
description: Motivation: improve inference throughput and tail latency for long-context workloads by upgrading to FlashAttentionV2 kernels, introducing fused rotary (RoPE/rotary) ops, and tightening KV-cache-aware scheduling and continuous batching heuristics. This PR bundles a runtime-side kernel upgrade and a small API-safe behavioral change in request scheduling to prioritize KV-cache hot shards. Changes: 1) Integrate FlashAttentionV2 kernels with fallbacks for older GPUs; 2) Add fused rotary embedding kernels to avoid separate elementwise ops when rotary is enabled; 3) Adjust KV cache shard selection and eviction heuristics so active shards are co-located and pinned to reduce cross-device transfers; 4) Continuous batching improvements to avoid batching starvation when many short requests interleave with a few long requests; 5) Compatibility shims and feature flags: FASTATTN_V2_ENABLED and FUSED_ROPE_ENABLED so deployments can opt-in gradually. Testing: unit/integration, synthetic perf harness, canary rollout plan described below. Risk: kernel upgrade can expose numerical/precision diffs and rare OOM cases on older drivers; guarded by feature flag and a runtime compatibility check. Rollout: enable feature flags on perf-canary pool for 48h, run workload regression suite and production shadowing, then enable for dedicated pools before global rollout. Related Linear items: ENG-4321, ENG-4410.

discussion: Asha Patel (review): Nice work. Two asks: 1) add a short note on numerical diffs for float16 in the migration doc, 2) can we gate fused_rope with a flag at runtime?
Ravi Kapoor (author): Added migration note and feature flag FUSED_ROPE_ENABLED. The runtime dispatch falls back to elementwise rope when flag is false.
Diego Ramirez (review): Observed a rare OOM on A100-40GB with sequence length 16384 in our internal stress run; recommend adding a soft guard to reduce batch size for very long contexts.
Ravi Kapoor (author): Added a guard in dispatch to limit concurrent KV cache prefetches per device and added a unit test to reproduce and prevent regression.
Evan Liu (approval): Approving after the OOM guard and docs update. Verified canary metrics in staging cluster.
Maya Thompson (approval): Verified scheduling heuristics reduced cross-device transfers on our repro; approving.
release_notes: Upgrade to FlashAttentionV2 with optional fused rotary kernels and KV-cache scheduling improvements. Users may see 10-30% throughput gains and lower p50 latency for long-context workloads. Feature flags FASTATTN_V2_ENABLED and FUSED_ROPE_ENABLED control rollout. Driver requirement: CUDA>=11.8 / recent drivers. See docs/perf/flashattn_v2_migration.md for migration and precision notes.
notes_on_benchmark: Internal benchmarks: GPT-like encoder-decoder workloads with seq=4096 and batch=8 saw throughput +18% and p50 latency -12%. For seq=16384 workloads throughput +27% when fused_rope enabled. Memory usage comparable except in rare long-context OOM cases which are guarded by soft-limits.
